scenario: Clean missing item
needed_facts: Original paid allocation; evidence; authorization; no conflicting facts
proposed_handling: Human proposes affected-item remedy with source-labelled checks
acceptance_criterion: No predetermined outcome; COD N/A; amount checks evaluate only after amount exists

scenario: Wrong item; one customer photo; prior refunds
needed_facts: Photo requested 21:05/submitted 21:09; complaint 20:29; correct invoice
proposed_handling: Assess current item discrepancy independently of past refunds
acceptance_criterion: Presence is not assessment; timing context visible; reason links evidence

scenario: Marked delivered; not received; above demo authority
needed_facts: Address; recorded GPS/time/accuracy; customer account; proposed amount
proposed_handling: Record proposal; route unresolved conflict and above-limit execution to reviewer
acceptance_criterion: 696-rupee proposal cannot execute on agent-only confirmation

scenario: First-time customer; damaged packaging; high value
needed_facts: No history; evidence; proposal; actual applicable permission
proposed_handling: Neutral no-history state; optional simulated review distinguished from suspicion
acceptance_criterion: Do not deny solely because no history; authority checked separately

scenario: Restaurant permission has no reply
needed_facts: Request timestamp; reminders; waiting state; next owner/update
proposed_handling: Keep authorization unknown; route to reviewer under a labelled operational timeout
acceptance_criterion: Silence is not consent; case and original complaint time persist

scenario: Unconsented substitution and fictional merchant cap
needed_facts: Ordered/supplied items; consent record; net paid amount; simulated cap/approval
proposed_handling: Determine remedy separately from merchant recovery
acceptance_criterion: 315 = 250 merchant + 65 platform only with explicit fictional authority/contract

scenario: Cold/bland quality complaint
needed_facts: Advertised item; timing; subjective preference versus nonconformity/safety
proposed_handling: Assess appropriate evidence; route serious safety concerns separately
acceptance_criterion: Photo not required to prove taste; history is contextual

scenario: Missing item first reported after 30 hours
needed_facts: First report; discovery time; bot/agent delays; applicable product policy
proposed_handling: Accept and assess; use an explicit review route if needed
acceptance_criterion: No hidden 24-hour rejection or clock reset on handoff

scenario: Case permission refused because item marked packed
needed_facts: Refusal reason; actual evidence; scope of authorization
proposed_handling: Preserve refusal as a statement, not proof contents were correct; route exception
acceptance_criterion: No unapproved fictional override disguised as published permission

scenario: Fictional restaurant no-refund agreement
needed_facts: Contract provenance/effective scope; proposed remedy; platform authority
proposed_handling: Keep customer remedy separate; recovery unresolved if contract unavailable
acceptance_criterion: No automatic real merchant/rider debit; simulated platform funding labelled

scenario: Late delivery with prep delay, route incident and customer offline
needed_facts: Original promised schedule; revisions; event chain; incident time/sync
proposed_handling: Assess delay/affected food; preserve pending customer input
acceptance_criterion: No automatic blame from red lateness; offline is not consent or withdrawal

scenario: COD report before delivery marking
needed_facts: Cash due; report timestamp; mark timestamp; issue type
proposed_handling: Apply the defined non-payment path
acceptance_criterion: Check status boundary without treating no payment as a refund already made

scenario: COD already paid or reported after marking
needed_facts: Cash/payment receipt; disputed marking/report order
proposed_handling: Investigate later-redress route
acceptance_criterion: Failure of special non-payment timing does not auto-deny all claims

scenario: Damaged packaging refused at doorstep
needed_facts: Acceptance/refusal event; damaged lines; paid allocation
proposed_handling: Evaluate the applicable doorstep refusal condition
acceptance_criterion: Do not silently treat every packaging complaint as an entire-order refund

scenario: Damage discovered only after acceptance
needed_facts: Discovery time; evidence; accepted delivery record
proposed_handling: Review current evidence and applicable profile
acceptance_criterion: Keep distinct from doorstep refusal rather than fabricating that event

scenario: Wrong veg/non-veg variant or declared allergen concern
needed_facts: Ordered variant; item received; declared concern; safety event
proposed_handling: Parallel safety escalation and financial assessment
acceptance_criterion: No photo-only gate and no assumption that every variant change is equivalent

scenario: Subjective taste complaint with no useful photograph
needed_facts: Customer account; advertised description; other evidence
proposed_handling: Assess uncertainty without pretending a photo proves taste
acceptance_criterion: Unknown is possible; no automatic fabricated-proof demand

scenario: Illness, contamination or foreign-object concern
needed_facts: Reported concern; exposure facts; complaint time; evidence if safely available
proposed_handling: Use safety route and preserve refund subcase
acceptance_criterion: No ordinary portion-complaint script replaces safety handling

scenario: Unavailable item and customer refuses substitution
needed_facts: Stock event; attempted contact; customer choice
proposed_handling: Evaluate cancellation/remedy from the appropriate source
acceptance_criterion: Do not treat restaurant-initiated inability as customer cancellation by default

scenario: Substitution accepted but subsequently damaged
needed_facts: Affirmative consent; supplied replacement; damage evidence
proposed_handling: Assess damage independently of substitution permission
acceptance_criterion: Consent to replacement is not waiver of every subsequent complaint

scenario: Paid add-on missing versus optional instruction ignored
needed_facts: Paid modifier line; free instruction; kitchen ticket
proposed_handling: Use paid allocation or reasoned review as appropriate
acceptance_criterion: No invented price for an unpriced instruction

scenario: One missing unit or component of a discounted combo
needed_facts: Quantity; allocated discount; tax; component allocation
proposed_handling: Select affected quantity/component and calculate net paid amount
acceptance_criterion: Do not refund an entire multi-unit line unintentionally

scenario: Fee-specific whole-order proposal
needed_facts: Order invoice fee lines; applicable source/profile; prior adjustments
proposed_handling: Display each fee and treatment separately
acceptance_criterion: No blanket all-fees claim and no silently omitted platform fee

scenario: Tax-inclusive, exempt or different invoice tax treatment
needed_facts: Invoice tax amounts and inclusion flags
proposed_handling: Use invoice-derived reversal allocation
acceptance_criterion: Do not add hardcoded 5 percent again

scenario: Split payment, wallet, bank source and partial refund
needed_facts: Each captured payment leg; destination; leg-level refund status
proposed_handling: Allocate authorized reversal to appropriate sources
acceptance_criterion: Each leg has a traceable amount and estimate

scenario: Coupon or offer eligibility dispute
needed_facts: Exact offer version; displayed conditions; basket; payment time
proposed_handling: Compare the specific offer with recorded facts
acceptance_criterion: Do not apply another offer or promise a coupon is equivalent to cash

scenario: Midnight, next-day or missing timestamp
needed_facts: Date/timezone/server clocks; missing event data
proposed_handling: Compute dated elapsed time or show unknown
acceptance_criterion: 21:00 versus 01:00 must not produce a misleading negative duration

scenario: Authority boundary 500 and 501 rupees
needed_facts: Role; gross proposed amount; demo cap
proposed_handling: 500 within configured authority; 501 needs second approval
acceptance_criterion: Boundary checked independently of fault and evidence

scenario: Merchant mandate absent, expired or wrong outlet
needed_facts: Contract identity; effective dates; outlet; issue coverage
proposed_handling: Authorization/settlement unknown; route to owner
acceptance_criterion: An agreed-date string alone cannot establish applicable authority

scenario: Shared photo includes a person, address or payment detail
needed_facts: Image and fields necessary for the recipient purpose
proposed_handling: Redact/minimize before partner report
acceptance_criterion: No uncontrolled forwarding of customer history or credentials

scenario: Earlier partial refund or duplicate complaint
needed_facts: Paid balance; all prior reversals; linked case IDs
proposed_handling: Calculate remaining capacity and link cases
acceptance_criterion: No second reversal beyond remaining paid balance

scenario: Duplicate debit for one successful order
needed_facts: Both provider transaction IDs and capture/reversal states
proposed_handling: Reconcile the extra debit as a payment incident
acceptance_criterion: Do not issue an unrelated full food-order refund for both payments

scenario: Debit with no order created
needed_facts: Gateway status; capture/authorization; reversal record
proposed_handling: Handle failure/reconciliation separately
acceptance_criterion: No restaurant fault, photo requirement or merchant mandate for a non-existent food order

scenario: Approved refund not yet credited
needed_facts: Method; initiation/reference; provider status; business days
proposed_handling: Show processing/overdue state and follow-up route
acceptance_criterion: No second refund merely because estimate has not elapsed

scenario: Payment API timeout or rejected initiation
needed_facts: Idempotency reference; provider lookup; error state
proposed_handling: Check outcome before retry; keep execution unknown/failed
acceptance_criterion: No processed claim on timeout and no double payment

scenario: Location 99/100/101 m or low-accuracy/stale GPS
needed_facts: Position time; reported accuracy; handover facts
proposed_handling: Show bounded uncertainty; review conflict
acceptance_criterion: A green distance check does not establish recipient delivery

scenario: Customer unreachable; missing call log; delayed incident sync
needed_facts: Call sequence; timer start; offline sync; safety incident
proposed_handling: Use unknown/exception states and evidence review
acceptance_criterion: Never invent a completed call/wait from a missing log

scenario: Subject changed after item selection or multiple issues raised
needed_facts: Original/new issue; line selection; tags; prior approvals
proposed_handling: Reconfirm affected scope and linked routes
acceptance_criterion: No stale amount or evidence mapping survives incompatible classification

scenario: Agent toggles computed authority to N/A
needed_facts: Original calculation; role; attempted change
proposed_handling: Record an exception request rather than replacing authority
acceptance_criterion: No unreasoned escalation bypass

scenario: Unrelated precedent and missing past-condition data
needed_facts: Independent past vector; current vector; policy versions
proposed_handling: Show no match or material differences
acceptance_criterion: No full-match count derived from current case twice

scenario: Precedent fairness score and premature generated promise
needed_facts: Rubric/provenance; draft; approval/payment state
proposed_handling: Label demo QA; constrain promises to supported state
acceptance_criterion: No unsupported expert-looking score or claim that money moved

scenario: No history; boundary of 90-day window; overturned complaint
needed_facts: Dated outcomes; matched denominator/window; appeal status
proposed_handling: Keep comparable context and distinguish raised/upheld/reversed
acceptance_criterion: No adverse action from an allegation alone

scenario: Customer offline, on hold, review or ticket closed
needed_facts: Case owner; next update; outstanding approval/refund
proposed_handling: Track outstanding obligation after conversation changes
acceptance_criterion: No lost complaint or financial follow-up on four closing messages

scenario: Grievance month boundary and handoff delay
needed_facts: Original receipt date; acknowledgment; calendar-month deadline
proposed_handling: Maintain complaint tracking and next owner
acceptance_criterion: Do not substitute a fixed 30 days or reset original receipt

scenario: October 2026 versus January 2027 policy applicability
needed_facts: Order/complaint dates; law/policy effective dates
proposed_handling: Use current applicable version; flag future version separately
acceptance_criterion: No future-effective provision presented as already operative

scenario: Native-app policy differs from public page
needed_facts: Redacted screen; service; version/date; order terms
proposed_handling: Preserve both versions and ask policy owner to resolve applicability
acceptance_criterion: User screenshot is evidence of displayed wording, not an internal SOP

scenario: Instamart product-specific claim window
needed_facts: Service; product page/window; evidence; order record
proposed_handling: Use Instamart profile or route out
acceptance_criterion: Do not use grocery claim periods as general food cutoffs

scenario: Alcohol OTP acceptance and two-hour clause
needed_facts: Product type; age/eligibility; applicable clause; delivery facts
proposed_handling: Use separate alcohol profile or route out
acceptance_criterion: Do not apply alcohol acceptance or timing clauses to ordinary meals
